csv_project_name: Design for ODNR Statewide Restrooms Renovation
csv_agency: Ohio Dept of Natural Resources Div of Parks & Rec
csv_scope_of_work: The Ohio Department of Natural Resources (ODNR) Division of Parks & Watercraft (Parks) is requesting professional services for design and construction of new or renovation of existing, public restroom facilities at various locations. Professional services will include, but are not limited to: rehabilitation of electrical, mechanical, HVAC, and water/wastewater systems; environmental, structural and geotechnical assessments; and design of minor building construction, which could include pre-fabricated buildings, and/or renovation. Anticipated work tasks for each project could include: On-site evaluation and meetings with facility staff to assess scope of work for individual projects. Preparation of investigation reports with alternative analysis, recommendations and cost estimates. Preparation of construction documents for selected rehabilitation or improvement projects. Application for and securing applicable state and local permits. Provide construction administration services through close-out. Initial projects have been identified at: East Fork State Park Mohican State Park Hocking Hills State Park Grand Lake St. Mary's State Park Delaware State Park Findley State Park Wolf Run State Park Mosquito State Park Maumee Bay State Park Lake Alma State Park East Harbor State Park

relevance_explanation:

- Focus is largely on building systems rehabilitation such as electrical, mechanical, HVAC, and water/wastewater.

- Statewide multi-site program may offer volume, but technical profile is weak for sbp.
- Building type is small utility/public restroom facilities rather than large or complex buildings of strategic interest.
fee_explanation: No explicit design fee is stated in the source. Only total construction cost of 25,000,000 USD is provided for a statewide multi-site restroom renovation and minor new building program.
references_qualifications: All disciplines requested. Professional services include environmental, structural, and geotechnical assessments, design, permitting, and construction administration. No specific minimum reference counts or qualification thresholds are stated in the source.
